label: Byblos (Ancient Gebal)

label: Baalbek (Heliopolis)

label: Khiam Detention Centre

label: Beaufort Castle (Qal'at Shaqif)

label: Qana (Cana)

label: Zahle

label: Grand Serail (Government HQ)

label: Baabda Presidential Palace

label: Ain el-Rummaneh
sub: Beirut neighbourhood; site of Apr 13, 1975 bus massacre that triggered the civil war

label: Banque du Liban

label: Nabatieh

label: Jounieh

label: Bint Jbeil

label: Tripoli Citadel (St Gilles)

label: Beit Eddine Palace

label: Evacuation Orders — South Lebanon

label: al-Saksakieh — 7 Killed

label: Nabatieh al-Fawqa Ambulance Strike
sub: IDF strike hits ambulance, wounding 2 medics, Jul 24, 2026

label: Beaufort Ridge Tunnel Demolition
sub: IDF destroys Hezbollah tunnel network with ~700 tons of explosives, Jul 30, 2026, after Jul 29 drone strike on bulldozer

label: Rome Talks — Seventh Round

label: Majdal Zoun IED / Tebnine Strike
